posture: Inform — a clean, quiet scan. Paid mastheads (AFR, SMH and the ACM regional titles) surfaced only recycled coverage of the inquiry and council stories at headline level and were not opened. Net: no new decision-grade or developing signal today; publishing an empty digest to preserve archive continuity and confirm the scan ran clean.
